usedFor: OpnForm collects submissions, and LeadConnector stores each respondent when “New Submission Created” runs “Create Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submission Created” in OpnForm, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A repeat respondent updates their existing contact instead of creating a duplicate.

watchOut: “Add or Remove Contact from Workflow” needs a contact ID, email or phone, so make sure the form collects one.
